event.title: Republic of Ireland Players to Wear Black Armbands for Match Against Israel
event.canonical_title: Republic of Ireland Players to Wear Black Armbands for Match Against Israel
event.summary: The Republic of Ireland football team plans to wear black armbands during their upcoming match against Israel to honor all lives lost in the Gaza conflict. This decision follows a vote by the players to proceed with the contentious game. The Israeli Football Association has expressed support for the match, stating that 'Football has won.'

timeline.title: Ireland Soccer Team Honors Victims with Black Armbands in Match Against Israel
timeline.summary: The Ireland soccer team wore black armbands and refrained from handshakes during their match against Israel, a decision made by the players to honor victims of recent violence. The Israeli Football Association praised the Irish squad for their commitment to proceed with the game, stating that 'Football has won.'
key_facts: Ireland players wore black armbands during the match against Israel.
Players decided to refrain from handshakes.
The Israeli FA commended the FAI and the Irish squad for continuing with the match.
